plugins.name: ai-council
plugins.description: Use when a plan or creative decision would benefit from several AI models working independently — running one brief through multiple assistants (e.g. ChatGPT, Grok, Gemini, an on-device model) and merging the results.

plugins.name: app-store-answer-check
plugins.description: Use before submitting a mobile app to the Apple App Store, Google Play or Samsung Galaxy Store — to verify privacy labels, data safety, age rating answers and listing claims against what the code actually does.

plugins.name: apple-on-device-llm
plugins.description: Use when you want to run Apple's free on-device language model (Foundation Models framework, Apple Intelligence Macs) from the command line for short private text tasks such as hooks, captions or summaries.

plugins.name: free-video-tools-check
plugins.description: Use when choosing free tools for making and scheduling short videos — checking what free tiers of AI video, voice, editing and scheduling tools really allow (credits, watermarks, commercial use) before relying on them.

plugins.name: launch-reveal-series
plugins.description: Use when planning a "Day N of showing you what we built" social video series to launch an app or product — counting features, structuring days, hooks, cliffhangers, per-platform posting and scheduling.

plugins.name: parallel-agent-queue
plugins.description: Use when coordinating several AI coding/research agents (Codex, Claude Code, Grok, Gemini CLIs or API runs) on one machine — keeping them busy from a job queue with safe limits, status files and usage planning.

plugins.name: reel-editor
plugins.description: Use when turning long raw footage (B-roll, archive or public-domain video, your own clips) into a short vertical reel or short, or when reviewing one — picking the moments, where to cut, assembling montages, rhythm, sound, captions, originality and credit.

plugins.name: secure-mcp-keys
plugins.description: Use when connecting a local MCP server that needs an access token (e.g. a desktop app's automation server) to Claude Code, Codex or other agents — keeping the token in the macOS Keychain instead of chat, files or shell history.

plugins.name: social-account-audit
plugins.description: Use when asked to review Instagram, Facebook, TikTok or similar account insights and turn them into a posting plan — audiences, active times, reach sources, follower trends and what content performs.

plugins.name: storage-cleanup-github-first
plugins.description: Use when a computer is low on disk space from development work — finding large project folders, making sure anything worth keeping is backed up to GitHub (or cloud storage) first, then removing what will never be used again.

plugins.name: mobile-launch-readiness
plugins.description: Review a mobile app for final launch readiness across feature flags, routes, accessibility, offline behavior, store materials, review access, build identity, and device QA.

plugins.name: beginner-persona-gap-review
plugins.description: Synthesize independent beginner-focused reviews into a deduplicated, code-checked gap list and a release disposition; use when assessing onboarding and early user value before expanding scope.

plugins.name: claim-verification
plugins.description: Verify important factual claims with traceable sources, dates, provenance, corroboration, and explicit uncertainty.

plugins.name: evidence-first-data-analysis
plugins.description: Analyze and validate datasets with reproducible, evidence-backed methods. Read-only by default; never fabricate metrics or perform data writes.

plugins.name: research-data-qa
plugins.description: Independently audit research datasets for structural integrity, evidence and provenance, coverage, contradictions, and readiness, with explicit fail-closed gates.

plugins.name: research-spreadsheet-architect
plugins.description: Design reviewable research tables and spreadsheets with stable schemas, traceable evidence, explicit uncertainty, and reproducible counts.

plugins.name: inventory-reconciler
plugins.description: Compare frozen independent records with a separate read-only catalog and prepare conservative match, conflict, duplicate, and unmatched candidate findings for human review.

plugins.name: social-research-reader
plugins.description: Read and compare public social content with clear evidence layers, source links, coverage limits, privacy safeguards, and no unauthorized access or unapproved spending.

plugins.name: rights-checked-image-download
plugins.description: Safely retrieve a small, bounded set of images from a specific public URL when official image sources cannot provide them. Creates source manifests; downloads remain uncleared until a separate rights review.

plugins.name: agent-permission-boundaries
plugins.description: Define actions an AI agent may complete independently and actions reserved for explicit human approval, including money, security settings, production, publication, and irreversible changes.

plugins.name: risk-based-review-gates
plugins.description: Set review effort from change risk, reviewer independence, and exact commit state; use when deciding whether a change needs no review, one review, or a full independent review.

plugins.name: decision-ledger
plugins.description: Maintain durable owner decisions in one living ledger and one issue thread, including superseded history and a parking lane for future paid work; use before starting work that depends on product or project decisions.

plugins.name: project-handoff
plugins.description: Close out a substantial project session with a source-backed checkpoint, preserved decisions and gates, concrete blockers, and next steps for a new person or agent.

plugins.name: open-source-privacy-scan
plugins.description: Scan a project before it becomes public for personal data, confidential names, local paths, credentials, internal tool references, and identifying Git history; use when preparing a repository for public release.
